description: Improve your supply chain workflows in Slack for Mac. Learn keyboard shortcuts, search tips, and how to use Lazur to manage your logistics communications.

intro: Slack for supply chain analysts on Mac is the central hub for coordinating logistics, inventory, and supplier communication. Using Lazur with Slack helps you navigate these high-volume channels by answering questions out loud and guiding you through complex interface tasks without breaking your focus.
tldr: Use Command + K to switch between logistics channels instantly.
Master search modifiers like from: and in: to find shipment updates.
Hold Option + Command to ask Lazur about any status or data on your screen.
Use Shift + Enter to draft multi-line messages without sending them early.
Clear your cache via Help > Troubleshooting if the app feels sluggish.

blocks.text: Managing logistics data in Slack for Mac

Supply chain analysts often juggle multiple workspaces. You might have one for your internal team and another for external suppliers. Keeping these separated is vital for data security and clarity. Use the workspace switcher on the left sidebar or press Command + 1 through 9 to jump between them. If you cannot find a specific shipment thread, press Command + K to open the quick switcher. Type the channel name or the person you are looking for.
Search tips for supply chain analysts

items: Use from:@username to find messages from a specific supplier rep.
Use in:#channelname to narrow your search to a specific project or region.
Use has:file to find invoices or shipping documents shared in a thread.
Use before:YYYY-MM-DD to find communications regarding past quarterly reviews.

blocks.text: Searching effectively saves time when you need to verify a purchase order number or a delivery status. If the search results are overwhelming, remember that you can filter by date or reaction. Lazur can help here. If you are stuck looking for a specific setting or a buried message, hold Option + Command and ask, Where is the search filter for files? Lazur will circle the exact button on your Mac screen.

Logistics moves fast. You need to be responsive without letting Slack become a constant distraction. Use the [pause notifications in Slack](/how-to/pause-notifications-in-slack) feature when you need to perform deep data analysis in Excel or SAP. You can set a status by pressing Command + Shift + Y. This tells your team you are deep in a report, reducing the number of incoming pings.

If you need to send a message later, use the [schedule a message in Slack](/how-to/schedule-a-message-in-slack) feature. Click the small arrow next to the send button to pick a time that suits your supplier's time zone.

blocks.text: How Lazur helps you stay in the flow

Lazur lives in your Mac notch. It does not replace your work, but it removes the friction of finding tools. When you are inside Slack, you might forget a keyboard shortcut or where a specific preference is hidden. Instead of clicking through menus, hold Option + Command and ask. Lazur will guide you through the process, waiting for you to complete each step.

You can also use Lazur to dictate notes. If you are on a call with a carrier and need to log a delay in a Slack channel, press and hold the fn key. Speak your update clearly. Lazur will format the text for you at the cursor. This keeps your hands on the keyboard and your eyes on the screen, which is essential for tracking complex supply chain data.

items: Sending messages in the main channel instead of a thread. Always use the reply button to keep the conversation history clean.
Ignoring the Unreads view. Press Command + Shift + A to see all your unread messages in one place.
Overloading channels with files. Use a cloud storage link instead of uploading large PDFs directly to Slack.
Forgetting to pin important documents. Use the [pin a message in Slack](/how-to/pin-a-message-in-slack) feature for PO numbers or contact lists that everyone needs.

blocks.text: If Slack starts to feel slow, it is often due to cache build-up. Go to Help > Troubleshooting > Clear Cache and Restart. This is a common fix for analysts who keep Slack open all day with dozens of active channels. If you encounter a bug that prevents you from sending messages, check the Slack status page first. If the service is up, restarting the app is your next best step.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons in Slack for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or operate apps for you. It points out where buttons are and guides you through the process, but you remain in control of every action.

faq.question: Does Lazur work on Windows?
faq.answer: Lazur is currently built for macOS only. It works on both Apple silicon and Intel-based Macs.

faq.question: How do I find my Slack keyboard shortcuts?
faq.answer: Press Command + / while in the Slack desktop app to open the full list of available shortcuts.

faq.question: Is my data private when using Lazur?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur only sees your screen and listens to your voice while you are holding the shortcut key. Your data is not stored or used to train AI models.
